facts.raw_span: A 35-year-old woman presented 11 weeks postpartum with right breast erythema and pain
three prior episodes of similar symptoms treated at outside hospitals
Medical history includes depression and previous treatment with cabergoline until 2016
hormone levels were normal during her first trimester of pregnancy
excessive amount of milk despite attempts to wean
No recurrent headaches or visual changes were reported
5 cm × 8 cm area of erythema and induration on the medial aspect of the right breast
milky, nonpurulent discharge was easily expressed from both breasts
Leukocyte count: 19.1 × 10⁹/L
Prolactin: 72.3 ng/mL
Anaerobic culture: Positive for Streptococcus agalactiae, susceptible to penicillin
Slightly heterogeneous appearance of the pituitary gland without evidence of discrete mass or lesion
